  "tokenized_directions": [
    {
      "step": 1,
      "text": "{{ing_01|Pieces of cooked sow’s udder}}, {{ing_02|pieces of cooked fish}}, {{ing_03|chicken meat and similar bits}}, mince uniformly, season well and carefully [2]."
    },
    {
      "step": 2,
      "text": "Take a metal dish [for a mould]. Break {{ing_04|eggs}} [in another bowl] and beat them."
    },
    {
      "step": 3,
      "text": "In a mortar put {{ing_05|pepper}}, {{ing_06|lovage}} and {{ing_07|origany}} [3], which crush; moisten [this] with {{ing_08|broth}}, {{ing_09|wine}}, {{ing_10|raisin wine}} and {{ing_11|a little oil}}; empty it into the bowl [with the beaten eggs, mix] and heat it [in the hot water bath]."
    },
    {
      "step": 4,
      "text": "Thereupon when [this is] thickened mix it with the pieces of meat."
    },
    {
      "step": 5,
      "text": "Now prepare [alternately] layers of stew and {{ing_12|pancakes}}, interspersed with {{ing_13|oil}} [in the metal mould reserved for this purpose] until full, cover with one real good {{ing_12|pancake}} [4], cut into it a vent hole for chimney on the surface [bake in hot water bath and when done] turn out upside down into another dish."
    },
    {
      "step": 6,
      "text": "Sprinkle with {{ing_05|pepper}} and serve."
    }
  ],
